   Thanks for your update. In this case, try to see if there are any settings on the graphics driver control panel or advanced settings. If that fails to control the brightness as well, it is advised to reinstall the graphics driver and then perform an in-place update of your Windows 10 once the problem persists.

   To reinstall the graphics driver, [...] To reinstall the graphics driver,

   Hold down Windows + X and open Device Manager > Expand Display Adapter > Select the graphic card > Click Properties > Uninstall > OK > And then access the brand’s official website to download the latest version of the graphics driver to install it to your Windows.
